title: Dr Iain Malone
text:
I develop new experimental techniques to reveal how electrochemical devices work and why they fail, advancing the energy transition through research in energy storage and conversion technologies.



Electrochemical Testing
Full cell device testing of performance and durability.


Operando Diagnostics
Identifying the causes of degradation with operando imaging and electrochemical techniques.


Method Development
Developing new experimental techniques to address electrochemical research questions.


Bridging Academia & Industry
Collaborative research that moves from lab to application.
